HIGH_RISK.title: High risk
HIGH_RISK.description: The message contains possible risk signals. Verify the situation independently before paying or sharing information; this result alone does not prove fraud.

VERIFICATION_RECOMMENDED.title: Independent verification recommended
VERIFICATION_RECOMMENDED.description: The message contains suspicious elements or an unverified link. This does not prove fraud. Check the request independently before acting.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.title: Insufficient evidence
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.description: No typical warning signs were detected in this text. That does not mean the message is safe. Verify any unusual request independently.

REMOTE_ACCESS_DEMAND.title: Remote-access software mentioned
REMOTE_ACCESS_DEMAND.description: The text mentions remote access or installing software. Do not grant access based on an unsolicited request; check its context independently.

SAFE_ACCOUNT_FRAUD.title: Account-threat or safe-account language
SAFE_ACCOUNT_FRAUD.description: The text contains language associated with an account being threatened or money being moved. This pattern alone does not verify the sender or prove fraud.

FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM.title: Possible payment request in a family conversation
FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM.description: A family or changed-contact context appears alongside a request for money. It may be a real relative or impersonation; verify independently before paying.

OTP_CREDENTIAL_HARVEST.title: Possible request for a code or password
OTP_CREDENTIAL_HARVEST.description: The message appears to request a verification code, password or PIN. Sharing these can allow account access or authorize transactions.

PACKAGE_DELIVERY_SCAM.title: Delivery problem or information-update request
PACKAGE_DELIVERY_SCAM.description: The message mentions a delivery problem or asks for updated details. Such wording can also occur in fraudulent messages; verify the parcel separately.

PSYCHOLOGICAL_URGENCY.title: Urgency or threatening language
PSYCHOLOGICAL_URGENCY.description: The text contains urgency, deadlines or threats. Pressure can make independent checking harder; the wording alone does not establish intent.

INVESTMENT_FRAUD_DETECTED.title: Investment or guaranteed-return language
INVESTMENT_FRAUD_DETECTED.description: The text contains patterns associated with investment promotions or guaranteed returns. Claims about returns and affiliation have not been verified.

MARKETPLACE_FRAUD.title: Marketplace payment or courier language
MARKETPLACE_FRAUD.description: The text matches patterns used in marketplace payment or courier requests. Verify payment through the platform or your bank before sharing sensitive information.

URL_USERINFO.title: Address contains information before an @ sign
URL_USERINFO.description: The part before @ is not the destination domain. Check the actual hostname independently. The link was not opened.

URL_IP_ADDRESS.title: Link uses an IP address
URL_IP_ADDRESS.description: The destination uses a numeric IP address rather than a domain name. This does not by itself prove fraud; verify who operates it.

URL_SHORTENER.title: Shortened link conceals the destination
URL_SHORTENER.description: A link-shortening service hides the final destination. The application did not follow the link or verify that destination.

URL_PUNYCODE.title: Internationalized domain name
URL_PUNYCODE.description: The domain uses international characters. This is not proof of fraud; check the intended name carefully.

URL_HOMOGLYPH_CHAR.title: Look-alike character in the address
URL_HOMOGLYPH_CHAR.description: The address contains a Cyrillic character that may resemble a Latin character. It may also be a legitimate international name.

URL_MISLEADING_SUBDOMAIN.title: Service name in a subdomain
URL_MISLEADING_SUBDOMAIN.description: A service-related word appears before the registrable domain. This does not prove affiliation or fraud; verify the operator independently.

IMPERSONATION.title: Possible look-alike domain
IMPERSONATION.description: The hostname contains a known brand name but does not match the configured domain list. The list may be incomplete; the address alone does not prove fraud.

AI.title: Possible signal proposed by AI
AI.description: The model proposed this interpretation of the quoted text. A matching quotation does not prove the interpretation is correct.

UNKNOWN.title: Possible risk signal
UNKNOWN.description: Review the quoted text and verify the request independently. This signal does not prove fraud.

REMOTE_ACCESS_DEMAND_1.action: Pause the conversation and do not install software on request
REMOTE_ACCESS_DEMAND_1.rationale: Remote-access software can allow another person to control your device and access sensitive information.

SAFE_ACCOUNT_FRAUD_1.action: Contact your bank using the number on your card or in its app
SAFE_ACCOUNT_FRAUD_1.rationale: Ask the bank to check the claim. Do not use a phone number supplied in the suspicious message.

FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM_1.action: Call your relative on their previously known number
FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM_1.rationale: A familiar greeting or a claim about a new phone number does not establish identity.

FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM_2.action: Ask a question whose answer you and your relative know
FAMILY_EMERGENCY_SCAM_2.rationale: An answer alone is not proof of identity; also use a previously known contact.

OTP_CREDENTIAL_HARVEST_1.action: Do not forward verification codes or approve unfamiliar banking requests
OTP_CREDENTIAL_HARVEST_1.rationale: A code or approval can authorize access or a transaction. Check the request through a trusted channel.

PACKAGE_DELIVERY_SCAM_1.action: Open the carrier’s app or a website address you already know
PACKAGE_DELIVERY_SCAM_1.rationale: Check the tracking number there instead of following the message’s link.

PSYCHOLOGICAL_URGENCY_1.action: Pause and resist pressure to rush
PSYCHOLOGICAL_URGENCY_1.rationale: An urgent deadline is not proof of legitimacy. Take time to verify the request through a trusted channel.

INVESTMENT_FRAUD_DETECTED_1.action: Independently check the investment provider’s authorization
INVESTMENT_FRAUD_DETECTED_1.rationale: Use the relevant financial regulator’s official register and check that the contact details match. Authorization does not guarantee an investment’s safety.

MARKETPLACE_FRAUD_1.action: Check the payment through the marketplace or your bank
MARKETPLACE_FRAUD_1.rationale: Do not provide a card security code or approve a transaction merely because a message claims this is necessary to receive money.

URL_VERIFY.action: Avoid opening the message’s link until you verify it
URL_VERIFY.rationale: The address has warning signs. Use an independently known website or app to check the request.

INDEPENDENT_VERIFY.action: Verify the sender through an independent channel
INDEPENDENT_VERIFY.rationale: Use a previously known phone number, app or independently located official website instead of contact details in the message.

semanticActions.SHARE_OTP: Possible request for a verification code
semanticActions.OPEN_LINK: Possible request to open a link

uncertainty: No automated system or AI can guarantee that unknown communication is safe. This result supports your own decision; it does not verify the sender, certify safety or prove fraud.
semanticSummary: The model proposed possible signals based on quoted parts of the message.
semanticMissing: The sender’s identity and the authenticity of the request have not been verified.
semanticUncertainty: The model can be wrong; a matching quotation does not prove its interpretation.
